dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL (OpenCOBOL) - uses SCREEN SECTION with FOREGROUND-COLOR/BACKGROUND-COLOR, LOCAL-STORAGE SECTION, RECURSIVE program attribute, inline comments with *>, and GOBACK; consistent with GnuCOBOL dialect
evidence: END PROGRAM Sudoku followed by nested Program-Id

purpose.domain_detail: Sudoku puzzle solver with interactive screen-based input and recursive backtracking algorithm
purpose.summary: An interactive Sudoku solver that displays a 9x9 grid on screen, accepts known values from the user, then uses a recursive backtracking algorithm (TABLE-ANALYSIS) to find all solutions. Results are displayed via a separate SHOW-SUDOKU-BOARD subprogram. The program uses COBOL SCREEN SECTION for terminal UI.

notable_features: RECURSIVE program attribute enabling recursive CALL
Multiple PROGRAM-IDs in single source file (nested/sequential programs)
Backtracking algorithm implemented via recursive CALL
88-level condition names for menu response handling
BLANK WHEN ZERO in screen fields
No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars but enough is visible to classify confidently. The program contains three program units: Sudoku (main), TABLE-ANALYSIS (recursive solver), and SHOW-SUDOKU-BOARD (display). The recursive backtracking approach and screen UI are well-structured for a demo/educational program. GnuCOBOL dialect is strongly indicated by the combination of features used.
